comment: DubSiren - classic analogue-style dub siren (rounded square oscillator with linear FM, shaped and square LFOs, Wail / Fast / Slow / Laser modes, foot-pedal trigger) feeding its own tape-style dub echo with wow and flutter. The input passes through untouched. Mono. Defaults give a classic dancehall two-tone siren: Fast, G#4 and B5, short burst, warm echo.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Trig
params.comment: Trigger: how the FOOT PEDAL (the effect's on/off footswitch) triggers the siren. 0 Hold (sounds while the effect is on, releases when off, echo rings out), 1 Pulse (each OFF -> ON press = one ~0.6 s burst, the ON -> OFF press does nothing), 2 SHold and 3 SPuls = the same two on the beat: the siren starts (and SHold stops) on the next beat of the Tempo knob's clock, which restarts at each twin flip, and the press does not restart the LFO. The footswitch latches, so only on/off is visible, not 'held down'.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: Siren-style LFO mode: 0 Wail (shaped uneven triangle, 15 semitones), 1 Fast two-tone (square LFO, 2x Rate), 2 Slow two-tone (square LFO, 0.5x Rate), 3 Laser (falling ramp that repeats).

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: Base frequency, 110 Hz..1760 Hz exponential (4 octaves). Default 48 = G#4 (415 Hz), the low note of a classic two-tone siren.

params.name: Rate
params.comment: LFO speed. 0 = Man: the LFO stops and the trigger fires a pitch envelope (Pulse drops, Hold climbs). 1..100 = free speed, 0.15 Hz..15 Hz exponential (default 67 = about 3.4 Hz, the classic two-tone wobble). 101..112 = synced to the Tempo knob: the time of one whole LFO cycle as a note value: 4bar, 2bar, 1bar, 1/2. (dotted), 1/2, 1/4., 1/4, 1/8., 1/8, 1/8T (triplet), 1/16, 1/32. Fast still runs twice as fast as the note value and Slow half as fast, as in the free range.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: FM depth: f = f0*(1+4*Depth/100*LFO). Default 34 = about B5 at the top with default Pitch (a classic two-tone siren). Applies to every mode, Man included.

params.name: Vol
params.comment: Siren level (linear, 0.3 x full-scale square at 100, so about -16 dBFS at the default 50). The echo is fed after this.

params.name: Time
params.comment: Echo time, ms = 50 + 0.095*screen^2 (50ms..1.00s), shown on screen. Default 40 = 202 ms, one LFO cycle at the default Rate. Changes glide like tape. Never synced to Tempo.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: Speed in BPM (40 to 240), shown on screen. It sets the LFO speed when Rate is set to a note value (the top of its range, 101..112) and the beat that Trig SHold / SPuls wait for. Flipping to the twin copy of the same BPM (120 <-> 321) restarts the LFO without changing the tempo: a host can send that on each downbeat. A plain tempo change does not restart it. SYNC RESET: the knob runs 0..441 and holds every BPM twice: 241..441 is a twin copy (BPM = screen - 201, so past 240 the screen shows 40 again; both copies show the BPM). Default 120. FOLLW (0..39, the bottom of the knob): follows the bar sync sent by an effect in an earlier slot, its BPM (120 until one is heard, the last one kept if it goes away) and its bars, which restart it like a flip of its own Tempo. On a BPM it ignores that and runs on its own. In slots 1-3 FOLLW needs Mozaic's Send knob on another slot.

params.name: Fdbk
params.comment: Echo feedback in percent, 100 = unity, up to 125 (self-oscillation, soft-clipped). 0 = no echo at all (Off); 1 and up = echo at a fixed level, with more repeats the higher you go. Default 70.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
